onboarding.step1.title: Welcome to Villmond Markets
onboarding.step1.body: VILCOIN is a free, risk-free reputation score — it can't be bought, sold, or cashed out. Predict outcomes to build your track record.
onboarding.step2.title: Odds shift as people bet
onboarding.step2.body: Each market shows the outcomes people are predicting. As more players weigh in, the odds move to reflect the crowd's view.
onboarding.step3.title: Ready to predict
onboarding.step3.body: Tap an outcome on any market to place your first prediction. You can switch to Expert Mode any time for deeper analytics.
